And the third:
that you do justice and do not oppress,
nor set oppressors over the subjects (literally: sheep of the pasture).
And the fourth:
that you send every year the tribute of the lands that you have taken,
according to the custom of those who were before you.
When you do these things,
you shall be honored by us with robes and honorable titles,
which will make your rule lawful,
and you shall not be a tyrant."
Now when Toghril Beg heard the embassy,
he said in reply to the first point:
"My forces are numerous,
and these lands do not suffice for them."
And the ambassador replied:
"Because you have devastated them;
and if you were to take the whole earth and devastate it,
it would not suffice for you and your people."
And in reply to the second point he said:
"These forms of oaths,
the scribes perhaps understand them,
but I, how am I able to take heed
not to violate [them], even in some small way, through my conduct?" And the ambassador said:
"When in all your heart you show submission and do justice,
you will not violate [them]."
And in reply to the third point he said:
"As for me, as much as I am able,
I am careful to be just;
but if any of the famished who are with me act unjustly,
what can I do?" And in reply to the fourth point he said:
"As for the tribute that you mentioned (or: he mentioned),
show me its amount,
and if I am able to bear it,
I will not withhold it."
And the certainty of the matter is this:
that he did not accept even one of the points.
And in the year one thousand three hundred and fifty-six [1356]
of the Greeks [1044-1045 AD], the city of Erzincan was submerged in water,
and only the courtyard of the sons of Cyriacus, who were Syrian {Suryaye} by race, was saved (were saved),
while a lake of water surrounded it;
for they were merciful and doers of good deeds to everyone.
And in the year 438
of the Arabs [1046-1047 AD], the Ghuzz conquered the city of Hulwan (Halah? /
Hillah?), and burned it,
and they tortured the men until they brought out all their hidden treasures and gave them to them,
and they raped their wives before their eyes,
and defiled also their virgins.
